title: Lumos Corelle dinnerware set
text: Lumos Corelle dinnerware set. What a disappointment.  Compare my photo with the ad photo.  The ad photo shows a light beige-ish contrast color with the blues.  That is NOT what you get - the yellow is very bright and only on the dinner plate.  The colors are NOT muted at all.  Further, the bread plates have a different color palate so they almost look they don't go with the dinner plates. You get bread (or what they call "appetizer" plates) cereal bowls and dinner plates - 6 of each.  NO cups.  The bowls get hopelessly stuck if you stack them!  I've never had a Corelle set do that. Design flaw?  I have to place paper towels between each one.  What a nightmare.  Further, one of the dinner plates was chipped, leaving a very sharp edge - so it had to be tossed for safety.  No loose chip was found in the packaging so it appears it may have been factory packed that way.  Honestly, I was really hoping for a more modern looking print - but with the garish yellow it is really cheap looking and retro - but NOT in a good way.  So disappointing.  I love Corelle dinnerware - as it is tough and yet lightweight.  Had high hopes but this stuff is really ugly in person. There are no complimentary pieces (besides "appetizer" plates) - so no mugs or cups or even salad size plates.  I wish I could box them back up... and return them - but the packaging could not be recovered to do that. I will likely donate them and learn an expensive lesson. Only purchase the design you have seen in person.
